
```{r}
#| include: true
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- paste0(Standard.target, " closure design earthquakes. Uniform Hazard Spectra (UHS) for maximum horizontal spectral accelerations Sa(Tn) in [g] with 5%% critical damping assuming site conditions with Vs30 = %d [m/s].")
ID.target <- .resolveDerivedIDTarget(
  DEQTable,
  "DEQ_SSE figure",
  suffix = ".site",
  target = .currentTarget("ID.target"),
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
Sa.log <- TRUE
Tn.log <- TRUE
Stage.target <- "Closure"
root <- here::here()
```
